recipeNotes: Unauthenticated route sweep taken from the route table in server.ts, then the authenticated write path (basket, checkout → pdfkit, b2b order → notevil/vm, file upload, data export) which is where the expensive dependency subgraphs live. sqlite3 native binding, finale-rest, i18n and swagger all participate.

phases.name: common
phases.detail: unauthenticated REST + static + the routes any visitor hits

phases.name: full
phases.detail: authenticated read+write path: login, basket, checkout (pdfkit), b2b order (vm), data export
